B2_tau_lambda: fixed per outer fold at CORE_A4 source-selected values; no new tau/lambda search
threshold: source OOF positive-logit 5th percentile, lower quantile; 95% source sensitivity target
development_scope: Repeatedly used five-centre internal cross-centre development, not independent confirmation
B5_auxiliary: site-mean score squared error against source-cross-fitted full-native site Brier advantage; no frame-advantage identification
B5_labels: teacher training, preprocessing, epoch/model choice must exclude each labelled recipient; source validation targets generated using source-training teachers
B5_admission: after core contribution report, within remaining original 168h budget; native recomputation required

B5_teacher_seed_policy: same 17/29/43, fold excludes recipient centre; exact source training patients listed privately

B2_capacity: local capacity-matched scorer uses a bias-free one-hidden-layer MLP plus genuinely trainable direct local feature paths: 9*floor((24+2D)/9) hidden/output weights and (24+2D)%9 direct weights; effective and allocated counts exactly equal to conditional scorer. Local linear and geometry remain explicit lower-capacity controls.
B5_teacher_optimizer: Adam lr=.003, fixed60 updates, source-blind seeded cycle of full and12 site-deleted native conditions; one condition per unique patient per update
B5_source_stop_rule: All five outer-source partitions must each have >=2/3 chosen seed fits beating zero and source-constant site-value MSE, with positive high-low actual average source Brier advantage. Freeze all source gates before any B5 outer prediction. On failure retain source/value/shuffled controls and stop B5 outer evaluation without additional search.

B2_source_admission_rule: Before B5 native additions: for each of geometry, matched local scorer, shuffled context controls, conditional source-selected AUC must have positive mean delta and positive delta in at least3/5 source partitions.
